text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh, wazzup? Did ya come all this way<n>just for me?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You betcha! I respect you a lot, so<n>I've been
practicing a special song<n>for you all week!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Now that's what I call style!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Let's hear it then. Ya better dazzle me<n>with
somethin' as loud and flashy as<n>Edo fireworks!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, ma'am! Bamboo Memory<n>presents... your
birthday song!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
HAPPY! BIRTHDAY! THANK YOUU! FOR<n>BEING BORN!
YEAH!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
INARI! SHE'S THE BEST! STRONGER<n>THAN! ALL
THE REST! WOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Soundin' more like a chant to<n>me! Thanks
Bamboo, ya hit me<n>straight through the heart!
